messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for customer 'starlane' on dedicated pool eu2-dedicated-01. p99 = 3.6s (SLO 2.0s). Triggered by 3 consecutive 5m windows. PagerDuty: pd_inc_98321. Link: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/alerts/98321
Samir P.: oncall paged? seeing a couple of noisy tails this morning but not this magnitude.
Priya S.: yep pagerduty fired and I got the page. I'm on it, connecting to metrics and logs now. dumping recent qps and tail latency graph: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/starlane-eu2
Lena G.: quick question — is this single-tenant noise or cross-tenant? If it's starlane heavy we should consider tenant isolation (evict or throttle) to protect other customers.
Priya S.: initial trace shows a spike correlated with long-token chat requests from starlane-prod (tenant_id=starlane-prod). 35% of requests over last 10m are >1k tokens. KV cache pressure looks high.
Charlie N.: sounds like prefix/KV cache thrash. Possible root cause: client started sending long history + high concurrency. Suggest two-pronged mitigation: 1) add temporary request-level rate limit for tenant, 2) move some traffic to fallback model variant with lower mem/latency.
starlane-ops: We're seeing timeouts on our side in eu-west-2 and customers are complaining. What's the mitigation ETA?
Priya S.: acknowledging — quick plan: (A) apply tenant throttling policy (soft 30% throttle) now, (B) spin up an additional fallback variant mL_small on eu2 to route non-critical background requests, (C) if latencies persist, evict largest in-flight requests from tenant for 10m. I'll start A and B.
Samir P.: Priya, before throttling can you confirm risk of 429s to their app? Starlane asked to avoid hard failures. Maybe prefer 503 fallback routing where possible.
Priya S.: good call. use gradual throttle + route new long requests to fallback model. patching routing rule now.
Priya S.: executing command:
```bash
rictl routing update --pool eu2-dedicated-01 --selector tenant=starlane-prod \
  --route-override "model=mL_small,priority=lower,condition=token_length>800"
```
Priya S.: routing update applied (txn 0x6af3). starting soft throttle:
```bash
rictl tenant throttle --tenant starlane-prod --pool eu2-dedicated-01 --qps 180 --grace 60s
```
Priya S.: throttle activated. monitoring.
Lena G.: adding isolation watch: if shared pool p99 doesn't drop within 2m of throttle, we escalate to eviction of high-cost sessions.
Charlie N.: I'm provisioning fallback model instances in eu2 now. ETA ~90s for initial replicas.
OpsBot: Incident note: manual action applied by Priya S. (routing override + tenant throttle). Status: mitigation_in_progress.
Priya S.: early signs good — per-tenant p99 for others dropping. overall pool p99 decreased from 3.6s -> 2.4s in first 2 mins. still above SLO but improving.
starlane-ops: We prefer graceful degradation vs hard errors. Are you returning partial results or retries?
Priya S.: we route long requests to mL_small which intentionally returns abridged summaries (configured with structured fallback). No 429s expected unless they exceed the new qps. We'll notify if 429s appear.
Samir P.: thanks. can you capture the top offending request hashes so we can follow up with Starlane product team?
Priya S.: pulling top request signatures now; results: 
- sig: a1f4c9 (chat-history=large, avg_tokens=1.4k)
- sig: b3d2e1 (batch-rerank spikes)
I'll attach to incident ticket.
Charlie N.: fallback instances up: 4 replicas mL_small in eu2. routing logs show 67% of long requests are being redirected.
Lena G.: watch memory pressure — KV cache size dropped 18% already. nice.
Priya S.: pool p99 is 1.95s now at 00:20 since start. below SLO. continuing 15m watch.
OpsBot: PagerDuty note: pd_inc_98321 acknowledged and reassigned to oncall Samir P. (escalation policy).
Samir P.: taking over for the handoff. Priya — please prepare short incident summary + list of mitigations performed and customer impact for postmortem. I'll stay on for the monitoring window.
Priya S.: summary: initial cause: high-concurrency long-context chat workload from starlane-prod causing KV cache thrash and p99 spike across eu2 dedicated pool. Actions: routing override to mL_small for token_length>800, soft qps throttle to 180 qps with 60s grace, provisioned 4 fallback replicas. Impact: temporary degraded responses for long requests (abridged outputs), no hard 429s observed. Timeline/logs attached to ticket pd_inc_98321.
starlane-ops: thanks, appreciate the careful approach. we'll inform product and scale down non-critical customers.
Samir P.: final: leaving throttle in place for 30m then gradual rollback. assigning postmortem to eng-ml follow-up. closing war-room in 30m if stable. tagging support/eng. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Incident status: mitigation_stable. next_update: +15m.
Priya S.: copying note to #postmortems and will file a runbook entry for tenant-isolation pattern after this.
Samir P.: end of active mitigation. handoff: Samir (oncall) -> Priya (post-incident owner).
Priya S.: acknowledged. closing thread when 30m stable window completes.
OpsBot: Incident closed (auto) at 3301234725 after stable window.
